definitions.explanation: The main part of the human or animal body excluding the head, arms, and legs.

definitions.gloss: fuselage, body (of a vehicle or aircraft)
definitions.explanation: The main body of an aircraft, ship, or other vehicle, excluding wings, tail, and other appendages.

examples.japanese: {胴体|どうたい}をひねる{運動|うんどう}をした。
examples.english: I did exercises that twist the torso.

examples.japanese: この{彫刻|ちょうこく}は{胴体|どうたい}だけで{頭|あたま}がない。
examples.english: This sculpture has only a torso and no head.

examples.japanese: {選手|せんしゅ}は{胴体|どうたい}の{筋肉|きんにく}を{鍛|きた}えるトレーニングを{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: The athlete continues training to strengthen the muscles of the torso.

examples.japanese: {飛行機|ひこうき}の{胴体|どうたい}に{亀裂|きれつ}が{見|み}つかった。
examples.english: A crack was found in the fuselage of the airplane.

examples.japanese: この{機体|きたい}は{胴体|どうたい}が{広|ひろ}く、{座席|ざせき}が{横|よこ}に{九|きゅう}つ{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: This aircraft has a wide fuselage with nine seats across.

examples.japanese: {胴体|どうたい}{着陸|ちゃくりく}とは{車輪|しゃりん}を{出|だ}さずに{着陸|ちゃくりく}することだ。
examples.english: A belly landing is landing without deploying the landing gear.

notes:
USAGE:
For the body sense, {胴体|どうたい} refers specifically to the trunk — the core body minus limbs and head. This distinguishes it from {体|からだ} (the whole body) and {胴|どう} (the torso in martial arts or armor contexts).

For aircraft, {胴体|どうたい} is the standard term for the fuselage, parallel to English aviation terminology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {胴体|どうたい}{着陸|ちゃくりく}: belly landing
- {胴体|どうたい}をひねる: to twist the torso
- {胴体|どうたい}の{筋肉|きんにく}: torso muscles
- {飛行機|ひこうき}の{胴体|どうたい}: airplane fuselage
